firm_data.firm_description: Day Pitney LLP empowers businesses and private clients to navigate complex landscapes while fostering stability and growth. The firm offers comprehensive legal services.
notable_facts: Day Pitney has 17 attorneys who are Fellows of The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel (ACTEC).
Kritika Bharadwaj has been named to Lawdragon’s 100 Leading Global AI & Legal Tech Advisors list for the third consecutive year.
technology_signals: Kritika Bharadwaj is a Technology Partner at the firm, indicating a focus on technology and AI.

email.subject: AI for Day Pitney LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Gregory,

With 17 ACTEC Fellows on your team, Day Pitney is clearly a powerhouse in Trust & Estates. What caught my attention, though, is Kritika's role as your Technology Partner, which signals you're thinking strategically about how AI can strengthen your practice.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Hartford area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
